status: Frozen before opening the Battery Materials Property Database v2.0 archive payload.
purpose: Test whether experimental conductivity knowledge improves sparse-label prediction of rate-conditioned battery capacity in publication- and chemistry-OOD regions.
scientific_hypothesis: A conductivity model trained on independent experimental reports supplies a transport descriptor that is missing from sparse capacity labels. Benefit should concentrate in rate-conditioned, conductivity-supported chemical OOD regions and should disappear after source-label shuffling.
claim_guard: A positive result establishes one retrospective, rate-conditioned conductivity-to-capacity borrowing edge in a literature-mined experimental battery corpus. It does not establish universal battery transfer, prospective discovery, or improvement in cycle life.

primary_endpoint.description: Gravimetric capacity with an explicit current-rate condition and an explicit or bounded early-cycle condition.
primary_endpoint.allowed_rate_condition: dimensionless C-rate or a source-normalized equivalent explicitly represented in the released schema
primary_endpoint.early_cycle_definition: cycle number at most 10; an explicitly identified initial or first-cycle record is equivalent
primary_endpoint.temperature_handling: Use explicit temperature as a state feature. Missing temperature is retained with a missingness indicator and reported as a sensitivity stratum.
forbidden_post_audit_changes: selecting a different capacity subset because it gives a larger transfer effect
changing the primary target to cycle life or total device performance
choosing units or condition bins after inspecting capacity values

allowed: row counts and missingness counts excluding numeric property values

split_and_ood.external_publication_rule: A normalized publication identifier is external when the first eight hexadecimal digits of SHA256(identifier), interpreted as an integer, are divisible by five.
split_and_ood.primary_scope: the 40 percent of conductivity-supported external records with the lowest similarity to labelled recipient materials

source_card.primary: Publication-excluded conductivity ensemble mean, dispersion, source support, and missingness indicators.
source_card.strict_diagnostic: The same card after excluding all exact recipient materials from donor training.
controls: voltage card trained with the same pipeline
energy card trained with the same pipeline

features.material: Elemental composition when a formula is parseable; otherwise a fixed, outcome-independent hashed character representation of the normalized material string.
forbidden: numeric target property values outside model labels

models.seed_pairing: Every method uses identical recipient draws, evaluation records, and learner seeds.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over the four named contrasts at the primary budget and scope

leakage_sentinels: The design file exists before the archive payload is opened.
Numeric property values are not read by the pre-outcome audit.
No external publication enters recipient training.
No external publication enters the donor model used for its source card.
Source-card predictions for labelled recipient records are publication-out-of-fold.
All controls share identical recipient rows and card dimensionality.
Positive, null, harmful, and abstaining outcomes are archived without replacement.

compute.local_stage: Download, archive verification, schema discovery, and outcome-blind eligibility audit.
compute.balam_stage: One checkpointed full benchmark after the audit passes.
compute.network: The verified public archive is packaged before compute-node execution.
